text: Not a value. Poor customer support, there was none. Have had two of these products. The first would run for less then ten minutes before loosing a charge. Amazon replaced it. The second one is worse. I used this it twice, then put is away for a while keeping it charged. When tired to use it again it is not working at all. I could not return it since the return date has expired. Amazon would not help this time. I received a website to discuss the malfunction of machine it still shows a solid green for charge but no power at all. They have not responded. It has been 10 days since I sent in my request. I will not buy another product from this company.
